metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Reader Contract (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Load Order • Non-Goals • Forbidden Inventions • Output Schema • Refusal Rules
metadata.description: Defines how an external system must load, interpret, and execute the FFT AI Edition v1.3 canon.

non_goals: This edition does not revise RTT v0.9.
This edition does not redefine SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
This edition does not replace the human FFT book.
This edition does not invent new substrate classes.
This edition does not generate unverified scores.
forbidden_inventions: Inventing C1, C2, C3, paradox_density, or lattice_stability values.
Inventing invariants not present in fft.invariant.json.
Inventing operators or regimes not present in fft.operators.json or fft.regimes.json.
Inventing substrate classes or kernel types.

refusal_rules.unverified_substrate: Refuse execution if substrate compatibility is not validated.
refusal_rules.missing_measures: Refuse execution if any SPEC threshold lacks a measure ID.
refusal_rules.consent_violation: Refuse AA3 escalation if operator_consent != true.
refusal_rules.skip_resolution: Refuse any attempt to bypass RTT12 collapse.
